descriptions.CN:
[h1]房车生活 / Mobile Living[/h1]

[h2]3.11[/h2]

3.11：新增可展开的车顶太阳能板，为车辆辅助电池充电，支持直接使用材料安装及沙盒开关，车辆移动时自动收回；改善行李架受光，修复原版维修工具识别、多人动作参数及机械作弊兼容。

把受支持的车辆改装成移动生活空间，安装床铺、储物柜、家电和车顶装备。

支持 B42.20 单人、多人及专用服务器。

[h2]功能特色[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]车内生活：[/b]安装床铺、柜台、储物柜、小冰箱、微波炉、电视和洗烘一体机，在车内休息、收纳和使用设备。

[*][b]饮水与供电：[/b]车载电源支持生活设备；配备水箱的车型支持储水、净化和液体转移。耗电可通过沙盒选项调整。

[*][b]车顶装备：[/b]为受支持的原版车型安装行李架、发电机、储物箱、帐篷、油罐、瓦斯罐及备胎。

[*][b]车顶射灯：[/b]独立安装，使用车辆主电瓶供电，随原车大灯开关。

[*][b]车辆防护：[/b]焊接安装车窗护甲和前后防撞杠，具有独立耐久与破损外观；拆毁可回收部分材料。

[*][b]快捷使用：[/b]行李架上的瓦斯罐及车辆水箱可以在车旁边直接使用。

[*][b]底盘改良：[/b]可以大幅提升车辆负重能力。

[*][b]快捷菜单：[/b]可以直接在车身附近对行李架上的发电机、汽油罐、瓦斯罐和自带水箱进行快捷操作。可通过沙盒选项关闭。

[*][b]顶部空间：[/b]可安装吊柜，或者换装咖啡机、烤面包机，使用副电瓶供电。

[*][b]车顶太阳能：[/b]使用材料安装太阳能板，停车展开后为车辆辅助电池充电，车辆移动时自动收回。沙盒开关控制整项功能。
[/list]

[h2]支持范围[/h2]

[list]
[*]原版 StepVan、Van、SUV、PickUpVan 及指定变种，包括邮政版。客运 Van 可安装车顶装备，但不增加车内生活空间。

[*]不改装 PickUpTruck、指定警用／救护／广播等特殊车型，以及损毁、烧毁车辆。

[*]可选 KI5 Campers! 适配，为六款受支持房车增加生活设备位与净水箱，同时保留原有座位、床位和储物功能。车顶改装及新增护甲仅限受支持的原版车型。

[*]可选 KI5 F700 适配，为运钞车、SWAT 厢式车及校车、囚车、军用巴士增加生活设备位与水箱，同时保留原有储物功能；SWAT 和巴士可将原后排座位改装为生活设备。
[/list]

[h2]启用方式[/h2]

[list]
[*]原版车辆：启用 VehicleLivingSlots，无需其他 Mod。

[*]KI5 房车：额外启用 VehicleLivingSlotsKI5Campers，并安装 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3670064951]KI5 Campers![/url] 和 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url]。

[*]KI5 F700：额外启用 VehicleLivingSlotsKI5F700，并安装 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3110911330]'87 Ford B700/F700 Trucks[/url] 和 [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url]。

[*]通过车辆维修界面安装设备，所需材料、工具和技能以菜单提示为准。固定设施采用拆毁方式移除。

[*]多人游戏客户端与服务器须使用一致版本。
[/list]
descriptions.CH:
[h1]繁體中文：3.11 更新[/h1]

3.11：新增可展開的車頂太陽能板，為車輛輔助電池充電，支援直接使用材料安裝及沙盒開關，車輛移動時自動收回；改善行李架受光，修復原版維修工具識別、多人動作參數及機械作弊相容。

[b]車頂太陽能：[/b]使用材料安裝太陽能板，停車展開後為車輛輔助電池充電，車輛移動時自動收回。沙盒開關控制整項功能。
descriptions.EN:
[h1]English[/h1]

[h2]3.11[/h2]

3.11: Added deployable rooftop solar panels with auxiliary-battery charging, direct-material installation and a sandbox switch; panels retract on vehicle movement. Improved roof-rack lighting and fixed native mechanics tool detection, multiplayer action arguments and mechanics-cheat compatibility.

Turn supported vehicles into mobile living spaces with beds, storage, appliances and roof equipment.

Supports B42.20 single-player, multiplayer and dedicated servers.

[h2]Features[/h2]

[list]
[*][b]Living space:[/b] Install beds, counters, storage cabinets, mini fridges, microwaves, washer/dryer and televisions for resting, storage and appliance use.

[*][b]Water and power:[/b] Vehicle power supplies living equipment. Vehicles with tank slots support water storage, purification and fluid transfers. Power consumption is configurable in Sandbox Options.

[*][b]Roof equipment:[/b] Fit supported vanilla vehicles with racks, generators, storage boxes, packed tents, fuel cans, propane tanks and spare tyres.

[*][b]Roof spotlights:[/b] Install them individually. They use the main vehicle battery and switch together with the original headlights.

[*][b]Vehicle protection:[/b] Weld on window armor and front/rear bumper guards with separate durability and damage visuals. Destructive removal recovers some materials.

[*][b]Quick access:[/b] Propane tanks stored on the roof rack and vehicle water tanks can be used directly while standing beside the vehicle.

[*][b]Improved chassis:[/b] Significantly increases the vehicle's carrying capacity.

[*][b]Quick menus:[/b] Directly operate roof-rack generators, petrol cans, propane tanks and built-in water tanks while standing near the vehicle. These menus can be disabled in Sandbox Options.

[*][b]Overhead space:[/b] Install wall cabinets or fit a coffee maker or toaster powered by the auxiliary battery.

[*][b]Rooftop solar:[/b] Install panels from materials and deploy them while parked to charge the auxiliary battery. Panels retract on vehicle movement; the sandbox switch controls the entire feature.
[/list]

[h2]Supported vehicles[/h2]

[list]
[*]Vanilla StepVan, Van, SUV, PickUpVan and selected variants, including postal vans. Passenger Vans support roof equipment but do not gain additional interior living space.

[*]PickUpTrucks, specified police, ambulance and broadcast variants, wrecks and burnt vehicles are excluded.

[*]Optional KI5 Campers! support adds living-equipment slots and clean-water tanks to six supported campers while retaining their original seats, beds and storage. Roof upgrades and added armor are limited to supported vanilla vehicles.

[*]Optional KI5 F700 support adds living-equipment positions and water tanks to the armored bank truck, SWAT van, and School, Prison and Military Buses while retaining their original storage. SWAT and Bus rear seats can be exchanged for living equipment.
[/list]

[h2]Setup[/h2]

[list]
[*]Vanilla vehicles: enable VehicleLivingSlots. No other Mod is required.

[*]KI5 campers: also enable VehicleLivingSlotsKI5Campers and install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3670064951]KI5 Campers![/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url].

[*]KI5 F700: also enable VehicleLivingSlotsKI5F700 and install [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3110911330]'87 Ford B700/F700 Trucks[/url] and [url=https://steamcommunity.com/workshop/filedetails/?id=3171167894]damnlib[/url].

[*]Use the vehicle mechanics menu to install equipment. The menu lists the required materials, tools and skills. Fixed fittings require destructive removal.

[*]Multiplayer clients and servers must use matching versions.
[/list]

[b]Workshop ID:[/b] 3791192579
[b]Mod ID:[/b] VehicleLivingSlots
